title: Dense rank
skill: Say how ties are ranked and ordered

good: Fix rank(players) in src/rank.js. Rules: 1) sort by score, highest first; 2) dense ranks: equal scores share a rank and the next score gets the next number (100, 90, 90, 80 -> 1, 2, 2, 3, not 1, 2, 2, 4); 3) equal scores are sorted by name A-Z ignoring case, compare name.toLowerCase() with < and >, not localeCompare; 4) names that are equal ignoring case keep input order (stable sort); 5) return a new array of { rank, name, score } with only those three fields. Do not change other files. Then run: node --test test/*.test.js
